This '''national electoral calendar for 2011''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2011 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
*9–15 January: [[Politics of South Sudan|South Sudan]], [[2011 South Sudanese independence referendum|Independence Referendum]]
*23 January:
**[[Elections in the Central African Republic|Central African Republic]], [[2011 Central African Republic general election|President and Parliament (1st Round)]]
**[[Elections in Portugal|Portugal]], [[2011 Portuguese presidential election|President]]
*31 January: [[Elections in Niger|Niger]], [[2011 Nigerien parliamentary election|Parliament]] and [[2011 Nigerien presidential election|President (1st Round)]]

==February==
*6 February: [[Elections in Cape Verde|Cape Verde]], [[2011 Cape Verdean parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*13 February:
**[[Elections in Chad|Chad]], [[2011 Chadian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2011 Swiss gun control initiative|Referendum]]
*18 February: [[Elections in Uganda|Uganda]], [[2011 Ugandan general election|President and Parliament]]
*25 February: [[Elections in the Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], [[2011 Irish general election|Parliament]]

==March==
*4 March: [[Elections in Samoa|Samoa]], [[2011 Samoan general election|Parliament]]
*6 March: [[Elections in Estonia|Estonia]], [[2011 Estonian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*8 March: [[Elections in the Federated States of Micronesia|Federated States of Micronesia]], [[2011 Micronesian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*12 March: [[Elections in Niger|Niger]], [[2011 Nigerien presidential election|President (2nd Round)]]
*13 March: [[Elections in Benin|Benin]], [[2011 Beninese presidential election|President]]
*19 March: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2011 Egyptian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
*20 March: [[Elections in Haiti|Haiti]], [[Haitian general election, 2010–2011|President (2nd Round)]]
*27 March: [[Elections in the Central African Republic|Central African Republic]], [[2011 Central African Republic general election|Parliament (2nd Round)]]

==April==
*3 April:
**[[Elections in Kazakhstan|Kazakhstan]], [[2011 Kazakhstani presidential election|President]]
**[[Elections in Andorra|Andorra]], [[2011 Andorran parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*8 April: [[Elections in Djibouti|Djibouti]], [[2011 Djiboutian presidential election|President]]
*9 April:
**[[Elections in Nigeria|Nigeria]], [[2011 Nigerian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]
**[[Elections in Iceland|Iceland]], [[2011 Icelandic loan guarantees referendum|Referendum]]
*10 April: [[Elections in Peru|Peru]], [[2011 Peruvian general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]
*16 April: [[Elections in Nigeria|Nigeria]], [[2011 Nigerian presidential election|President]]
*17 April: [[Elections in Finland|Finland]], [[2011 Finnish parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*25 April: [[Elections in Chad|Chad]], [[2011 Chadian presidential election|President]]
*26 April: [[Elections in Nigeria|Nigeria]], [[2011 Nigerian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
*30 April:
**[[Elections in Benin|Benin]], [[2011 Beninese parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Laos|Laos]], [[2011 Laotian parliamentary election|Parliament]]

==May==
*2 May: [[Elections in Canada|Canada]], [[2011 Canadian federal election|Parliament]]
*5 May: [[Elections in the United Kingdom|United Kingdom]], [[2011 United Kingdom Alternative Vote referendum|Referendum]]
*7 May:
**[[Elections in Ecuador|Ecuador]], [[2011 Ecuadorian referendum and popular consultation|Referendum]]
**[[Elections in Niue|Niue]], [[2011 Niuean general election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Singapore|Singapore]], [[2011 Singaporean general election|Parliament]]
*19–21 May: [[Elections in Seychelles|Seychelles]], [[2011 Seychellois presidential election|President]]
*22 May:
**[[Elections in Cyprus|Cyprus]], [[2011 Cypriot legislative election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Vietnam|Vietnam]], [[2011 Vietnamese parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*28 May: [[Elections in Malta|Malta]], [[2011 Maltese divorce referendum|Referendum]]

==June==
*5 June:
**[[Elections in the Republic of Macedonia|Macedonia]], [[2011 Macedonian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Peru|Peru]], [[2011 Peruvian general election|President (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Portugal|Portugal]], [[2011 Portuguese legislative election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[June 2011 Slovenian referendum|Referendum]]
*12 June: [[Elections in Turkey|Turkey]], [[2011 Turkish general election|Parliament]]
*12–13 June: [[Elections in Italy|Italy]], [[2011 Italian referendums|Referendum]]
*17–19 June: [[Elections in Liechtenstein|Liechtenstein]], [[2011 Liechtenstein referendums|Referendum]]
*22 June: [[Elections in Palau|Palau]], [[2011 Palauan casino referendum|Referendum]]

==July==
*1 July: [[Elections in Morocco|Morocco]], [[2011 Moroccan constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
*3 July: [[Elections in Thailand|Thailand]], [[2011 Thai general election|Parliament]]
*17 July: [[Elections in São Tomé and Príncipe|São Tomé and Príncipe]], [[2011 São Toméan presidential election|President (1st round)]]
*23 July: [[Elections in Latvia|Latvia]], [[2011 Latvian parliamentary dissolution referendum|Referendum]]

==August==
*7 August:
**[[Elections in Cape Verde|Cape Verde]], [[2011 Cape Verdean presidential election|President (1st round)]]
**[[Elections in São Tomé and Príncipe|São Tomé and Príncipe]], [[2011 São Tomé and Príncipe presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*21 August: [[Elections in Cape Verde|Cape Verde]], [[2011 Cape Verdean presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*23 August: [[Elections in Liberia|Liberia]], [[2011 Liberian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
*26 August: [[Elections in Abkhazia|Abkhazia]], [[2011 Abkhazian presidential election|President]]
*27 August: [[Elections in Singapore|Singapore]], [[2011 Singaporean presidential election|President]]

==September==
*11 September: [[Elections in Guatemala|Guatemala]], [[2011 Guatemalan general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]
*15 September: [[Elections in Denmark|Denmark]], [[2011 Danish parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*17 September: [[Elections in Latvia|Latvia]], [[2011 Latvian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*18 September: [[Elections in Liechtenstein|Liechtenstein]], [[2011 Liechtenstein referendums|Referendum]]
*20 September: [[Elections in Zambia|Zambia]], [[2011 Zambian general election|President and parliament]]
*24 September: [[Elections in the United Arab Emirates|United Arab Emirates]], [[2011 United Arab Emirates parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*25 September: [[Elections in France|France]], [[2011 French Senate election|Senate]]
*29 September: [[Elections in the Isle of Man|Isle of Man]], [[2011 Manx general election|Parliament]]
*29 September–1 October: [[Elections in Seychelles|Seychelles]], [[2011 Seychellois parliamentary election|Parliament]]

==October==
*9 October:
**[[Elections in Poland|Poland]], [[2011 Polish parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Cameroon|Cameroon]], [[2011 Cameroonian presidential election|President]]
**[[Elections in Paraguay|Paraguay]], [[2011 Paraguayan expatriate voting referendum|Referendum]]
*11 October: [[Elections in Liberia|Liberia]], [[2011 Liberian general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]
*15 October: [[Elections in Oman|Oman]], [[2011 Omani parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*16 October: [[Elections in Bolivia|Bolivia]], [[2011 Bolivian judicial election|Judiciary]]
*19 October: [[Elections in Jersey|Jersey]], [[2011 Jersey general election|Parliament]]
*21/28 October: [[Elections in Kiribati|Kiribati]], [[2011 Kiribati parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*21/24 October: [[United Nations Security Council|United States]], [[2011 United Nations Security Council election|United Nations'Security Council]]
*23 October:
**[[Elections in Argentina|Argentina]], [[2011 Argentine general election|President and Legislative]]
**[[Elections in Bulgaria|Bulgaria]], [[2011 Bulgarian presidential election|President (1st round)]]
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2011 Swiss federal election|Federal]]
**[[Elections in Tunisia|Tunisia]], [[2011 Tunisian Constituent Assembly election|Constituent Assembly]]
*27 October: [[Elections in the Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], [[2011 Irish presidential election|President]] and [[2011 Irish constitutional referendums|Constitutional Referendums]]
*29 October: [[Elections in the Faroe Islands|Faroe Islands]], [[2011 Faroese general election|Parliament]]
*30 October:
**[[Elections in Liechtenstein|Liechtenstein]], [[2011 Liechtenstein referendums|Referendum]]
**[[Elections in Bulgaria|Bulgaria]], [[2011 Bulgarian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyzstan]], [[2011 Kyrgyzstani presidential election|President]]

==November==
*3 November: [[Elections in the Falkland Islands|Falkland Islands]], [[2011 Falkland Islands electoral system referendum|Referendum]]
*6 November:
**[[Elections in Guatemala|Guatemala]], [[2011 Guatemalan general election|President (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Nicaragua|Nicaragua]], [[2011 Nicaraguan general election|President and Parliament]]
*7 November: [[Elections in the British Virgin Islands|British Virgin Islands]], [[2011 British Virgin Islands general election|House of Assembly]]
*8 November: [[Elections in Liberia|Liberia]], [[2011 Liberian general election|President (2nd round)]]
*13 November:
**[[Elections in Equatorial Guinea|Equatorial Guinea]], [[2011 Equatorial Guinean constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
**[[Elections in South Ossetia|South Ossetia]], [[2011 South Ossetian presidential election|President (1st round)]] and [[2011 South Ossetian referendum|Referendum]]
*20 November: [[Elections in Spain|Spain]], [[2011 Spanish general election|Parliament]]
*21 November: [[Elections in the Marshall Islands|Marshall Islands]], [[2011 Marshall Islands general election|Parliament]]
*24 November: [[Elections in the Gambia|Gambia]], [[2011 Gambian presidential election|President]]
*25 November: [[Elections in Morocco|Morocco]], [[2011 Moroccan parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*26 November: [[Elections in New Zealand|New Zealand]], [[2011 New Zealand general election|General]] and [[2011 New Zealand voting system referendum|Referendum]]
*27 November: [[Elections in South Ossetia|South Ossetia]], [[2011 South Ossetian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*28–29 November: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2011–12 Egyptian parliamentary election|People's Assembly (1st phase 1st round)]]
*28 November:
**[[Elections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Democratic Republic of the Congo]], [[2011 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election|President and Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Guyana|Guyana]], [[2011 Guyanese legislative election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Saint Lucia|Saint Lucia]], [[2011 Saint Lucian general election|Parliament]]

==December==
*4 December:
**[[Elections in Croatia|Croatia]], [[2011 Croatian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2011 Slovenian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Russia|Russia]], [[2011 Russian legislative election|Parliament]]
*5–6 December: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2011–12 Egyptian parliamentary election|People's Assembly (1st phase 2nd round)]]
*8 December: [[Elections in Gibraltar|Gibraltar]], [[2011 Gibraltar general election|Parliament]]
*11 December:
**[[Elections in Côte d'Ivoire|Côte d'Ivoire]], [[2011 Ivorian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Transnistria|Transnistria]], [[2011 Transnistrian presidential election|President (1st round)]]
*12 December:
**[[Elections in the Pitcairn Islands|Pitcairn Islands]], [[2011 Pitcairn Islands general election|Islands Council]]
*14–15 December: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2011–12 Egyptian parliamentary election|People's Assembly (2nd phase 1st round)]]
*17 December: [[Elections in Gabon|Gabon]], [[2011 Gabonese legislative election|Parliament]]
*21–22 December: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2011–12 Egyptian parliamentary election|People's Assembly (2nd phase 2nd round)]]
*25 December: [[Elections in Transnistria|Transnistria]], [[2011 Transnistrian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*29 December: [[Elections in Jamaica|Jamaica]], [[2011 Jamaican general election|Parliament]]

==Indirect elections==
*4 February: [[Elections in Myanmar|Myanmar]], [[Presidential Electoral College#2011 election|President]]
*22 February and 7 April: ''[[Elections in Kosovo|Kosovo]], [[2011 Kosovan presidential elections|President]]''
*1 April: [[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[Captains Regent]]
*26–27 April: [[Elections in the Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], [[24th Seanad|Senate]]
*11 May: [[Politics of the Federated States of Micronesia|Federated States of Micronesia]], [[2011 Micronesian parliamentary election#Presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://fsmgov.org/press/pr051211.htm|title=Seventeenth Congress of the FSM Elects the President and Vice President of the FSM|publisher=Government of the Federated States of Micronesia|date=12 May 2011|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*23 May: [[Elections in the Netherlands|Netherlands]], [[2011 Dutch Senate election|Senate]]
*2 June: [[Elections in Latvia|Latvia]], [[2011 Latvian presidential election|President]]
*15 June: [[Elections in Laos|Laos]], [[2011 Laotian presidential election|President]]
*22 July: [[Elections in India|India]], [[2011 Rajya Sabha elections|Council of States]]
*25 July: [[Elections in Vietnam|Vietnam]], [[2011 Vietnamese legislative election#Aftermath|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/vietnamese/vietnam/2011/07/110725_vietnamese_president|title=Mr. Truong Tan Sang is the State President|work=[[BBC News]]|language=vi|date=25 July 2011|access-date=21 December 2020}}</ref>
*19 August: [[Elections in Kazakhstan|Kazakhstan]], [[2011 Kazakh Senate election|Senate]]
*29 August: [[Elections in Estonia|Estonia]], [[2011 Estonian presidential election|President]]
*25 September: 
**[[Elections in France|France]], [[2011 French Senate election|Senate]]
**[[Elections in Rwanda|Rwanda]], [[2011 Rwandan senatorial election|Senate]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newtimes.co.rw/section/read/35293|title=All set for Senatorial elections|work=[[The New Times (Rwanda)|The New Times]]|date=25 September 2011|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*1 October: [[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[Captains Regent]]
*9 October: [[Elections in the Republic of the Congo|Republic of the Congo]], [[2011 Republic of the Congo senatorial election|Senate]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.republicoftogo.com/Toutes-les-rubriques/Afrique/Elections-senatoriales-au-Congo2|title=Senate elections in Congo|publisher=Republic of Togo|language=fr|date=9 October 2011|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*10 November: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[2011 Nauruan presidential election|President]]<ref name="nauru">{{cite web|url=http://www.smh.com.au/world/another-president-ousted-in-nauru-20111115-1ngj2.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111123161450/http://www.smh.com.au/world/another-president-ousted-in-nauru-20111115-1ngj2.html|title=Another president ousted in Nauru|work=[[The Sydney Morning Herald]]|date=15 November 2011|archive-date=23 November 2011|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*15 November: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[2011 Nauruan presidential election|President]]<ref name="nauru" /> (new election)
*20 November: [[Elections in Spain|Spain]], [[2011 Spanish general election#Senate|Senate]]
*2 December: [[Elections in Moldova|Moldova]], [[2011–2012 Moldovan presidential election|President]]
*14 December: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2011 Swiss Federal Council election|Federal Council]]
